name: Guest Personalization
description: URL-based guest personalization (?g=<id>), showing personalized greeting, message, and optional photo. Graceful fallback for unknown guests
acceptanceCriteria: Guest data defined in lib/guests.ts as typed constant
Personalized greeting shows guest name (e.g., 'Xin chào Anh Tuấn')
Personal message displayed for known guests
Unknown guest IDs show generic content (no error state)
Guest name highlighted in invitation text
notes: Guest data is static JSON in lib/guests.ts. No database. Vietnamese names and messages.
